CLIPFARM x HIGGSFIELD CAMPAIGN BRIEF
Clip Alex Mashrabov on the 20VC podcast. Alex built Higgsfield, an AI video company. Find his best
moments. You earn money for every view.
CPM MAX PER CLIP MIN PAYOUT
$1.00 / 1K $350 $1.00
⚠ SPECIAL RULE: Do NOT change what Alex says. Never cut his words to make a new sentence.
Never make it look like he backs a product.
READ THIS FIRST — DON'T SKIP
Your clip must have the Higgsfield watermark. It must be big and easy to read. It must stay on the
whole clip.
QUICK FACTS
Client Higgsfield AI
Page Type Any
Content 20VC podcast clips — Alex Mashrabov talks with Harry Stebbings
Platforms Instagram Reels · YouTube Shorts
YouTube: @HiggsfieldAI + @20VC
Tagging
Instagram: @higgsfield.ai + @20vchq

Watermark REQUIRED — Higgsfield watermark on every clip
REQUIRED — English closed caption matching what is being said + your own
On-Screen Text
hook onscreen (first few seconds of clip - match what happens)
Length 30–60 seconds
Audience 40%+ of views from US, UK, Canada, Australia
✔ Pick one strong moment. Tell the whole idea. Make it look like the clips in the media kit.
❌ NOT the point: Clips with no watermark. Clips that twist what Alex said. Hooks that promise
something the clip does not show.
WHAT TO DO
It is easy. Just follow these steps:
1. Get our clips from the folder below.
2. Make a short video using ONLY the provided footage.
3. Add what is REQUIRED to the video and post.
4. Submit your video on Whop. Wait for your analytics and audience to fully load and clip to hit
minimum payout. Then open a ticket in Whop or Discord support chat for approval.
Not sure how to submit? Read the “How To Submit Clips” section.
WHERE TO GET THE CLIPS
Use ONLY the files from these links:
• Full podcast — the whole episode
• YouTube video — use it to find the times below. Cut your clip from the files above.
FOOTAGE EXAMPLES (USE AS INSPIRATION - DO NOT REPOST)
⚠ Do NOT use any clip from outside these links. Outside clips get rejected right away.
THE WATERMARK (REQUIRED)
Every clip needs the Higgsfield watermark. Get it from the Watermark Download. Add it yourself.
• Make it big. The words must be easy to read.
• Keep it on for the whole clip.
• Do not cover it with captions or text.
HOW TO MAKE THE CLIP (REQUIRED)
Match the style Copy the footage examples. Same pace, cuts, framing, and text.
Grab them in the first 2 seconds. Start with Alex's best line, a big number, or
Hook fast
Harry's short question. No intros.
One full idea 30–60 seconds. Give enough setup to get it. End on the answer.
Cut pauses and repeats. Keep it when Alex fixes himself or adds a "but."
Keep his meaning
Keep Harry's real reactions if they help.
WHAT TO CLIP
These work best. Pick one and clip it well.
WHAT WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE
Big money numbers A shocking dollar number first. Then the story.
Hot takes on AI Alex says something bold about AI. Then he says why.
Founder life His family, his son, and what building costs him.

WHERE TO POST
Post on these platforms.
1. Instagram Reels
2. YouTube Shorts
TAG THE CLIENT (REQUIRED)
Tag the client in your caption on every app. Tag the right handle for each app.
WHO TO TAG
Instagram @higgsfield.ai @20vchq
YouTube Shorts @HiggsfieldAI + @20VC
YOUR CAPTION (REQUIRED)
Write your own. Keep it short. It must match what is in the clip. No clickbait.
ON-SCREEN TEXT (REQUIRED)
Captions: Add English captions to the whole clip.
• Make them correct. Check names and numbers against the audio.
• Highlight the key word or number.
• Keep text off faces and app ui.
Hook: Add your own hook on top. Shows the first few seconds of the clip, like a “spoiler” to hook people in.
YOUR AUDIENCE (REQUIRED)
At least 40% of your views must come from: US, UK, Canada, Australia.
HOW TO SUBMIT (REQUIRED)
1. Post your video.
2. Copy the post link.
3. Submit it on Whop.
4. Submit your account / video demographics when the clip hits the minimum payout.
5. Wait for approval. Then you get paid.
